QuestInfo.name: There's a Limit to Everything
QuestInfo.0: You reached level 18 with the power of money! It's not a lot, but it's better than being level 10.
QuestInfo.1:
A little monster hunting would do you good. Return to the #bTraining Center#k after you assign all of your new Skill Points.


#questorder1##o3230300# #a254031#
QuestInfo.2: It was simple enough to remaster the skills you had... if only you could get stronger without all the work!

0.0: How is it, master? Do you feel stronger?\r\n#L0##bI feel something... but I'm only level 18! I still need 282 more if I'm going to get back to where I was!#l\n#k
0.1: I'm afraid even the master of all thieves cannot steal 300 levels. Hehehehe. \r\n#L0##bI wish you weren't so jovial when you made fun of me.#l\n#k
0.2: Is that why you keep paying me? Now put aside this nonsense and take some pride in your new abilities.\r\n#L0##bWhere is the pride in being level 18?#l\n#k
0.3: Oh, I'm sure you'll find it. I've refitted the #bTraining Center#k with a new #rmonster#k for you to practice on. Don't forget to assign Skill Points and Ability Points accordingly before you go.

yes.0: Allow me to refresh your freshly-thawed brain, if you would. #bLUK and DEX are both important for Thieves#k, but LUK is the more important of the two.
yes.1: You can also press the S key to view your stat window or the K key to open your skill window. I was sure you would have figured all of this out by now.

no.0: Certainly your newfound strength is not such a heavy burden on you. Please return to your training.

1.0: It appears the potion did not have any of those rather unfortunate side effects I had heard about. Thank goodness, I would hate to see you suffer from a bug.

mob.0: I believe you were heading to the #bTraining Center#k? Goodness, don't tell me you got lost inside your own home.
